item.title: Hultafors Group North America Recalls Lighted Portfolios, Angle Locators, Calipers and Calculators Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Button Cell Batteries
item.company: Hultafors Group North America, Inc., of Mequon, Wisconsin
item.brand: Hultafors Group North America, Inc., of Mequon, Wisconsin
item.product: Custom Leather Craft (CLC) Lighted Portfolio, Johnson Level & Tool (Johnson Level) Digital Angle Locator, Digital Caliper and Building Calculator
item.summary: This recall involves CLC Lighted Portfolio & Johnson Level Digital Angle Locator, Digital Caliper and Building Calculator, with the model numbers located on the unit and the package labeling. The following models, UPC Codes and retail prices are included in this recall.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Custom Leather Craft (CLC) Lighted Portfolio, Johnson Level & Tool (Johnson Level) Digital Angle Locator, Digital Caliper and Building Calculator.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled trade tools immediately, place them in an area inaccessible to children and contact Hultafors Group North America. To obtain a refund, consumers will be asked to upload a photograph of the product at www.HG2026.expertinquiry.com and certify that the product has been disposed of and will no longer be used. Upon verification, consumers will receive the retail price, as shown in table below in the form of a virtual Visa gift card. The virtual Visa gift card may be redeemed at any establishment that accepts Visa. Note: Button cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
